products.name: Grain
products.note: Meeting recording AI; highlight clips; CRM integration; consent and sharing

profile_text.body:
Grain is a San Francisco-based company founded in 2018 that offers an AI meeting recorder and conversation intelligence platform. The product captures video calls, Slack huddles, and in-person meetings, producing transcripts, summaries, coaching suggestions, and account insights. The company describes itself as built for growing teams, with a particular focus on small to mid-market and enterprise sales, customer success, and product teams. It supports over 130 languages for transcription and AI notes, with the highest accuracy for languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, and Japanese.

The Grain platform integrates with tools such as Claude and ChatGPT so that meeting data can be passed to external AI agents, and it includes CRM integration and highlight clip creation. A free plan is available with unlimited recordings and a 45-minute meeting limit and 90-day meeting history, while paid plans start at $15 per month per user and add advanced AI features, conversational intelligence, unlimited meeting length, and unlimited meeting history. The company states that neither Grain nor its subprocessors use customer data for model training.

The site's held facts show 161 California law exposure records associated with the company, which may reflect privacy or consumer protection regulatory filings connected to its data handling practices. No litigation cases or MCP server registrations are recorded in the current data.
